component_duties: County Attorney duties + District Attorney duties
notes: Texas Government Code § 44.229 creates the Kaufman County Criminal District Attorney and requires the office to perform duties conferred by law on county and district attorneys. The county publishes Erleigh Norville Wiley as the elected Criminal District Attorney; its Civil Division handles county legal and public-information work while the office prosecutes criminal matters. This is one elected office and one current holder, not three prosecutor offices.
